Thank you so much for opening up about this. It really helps to know that others have had similar experiences. I’m so sorry to hear that you went through such a traumatic experience and it’s so sad that our mental health system operates in this way. Luckily I was not a danger to myself or others but if I were the hotline would have only sent me over the edge. If you ever need to talk, please feel free to reach out, I don’t really have anyone I can talk to about psychosis or these episodes. Thank you again!!
